name: Wavelet Representation of Contour Sets
aliases: Adaptive Wavelet Representation of Contour Sets
definition: A method to represent scalar field contours as a hierarchy of meshes using subdivision surfaces and wavelets, allowing for compression via thresholding or encoding of wavelet coefficients.
summary: Wavelet Representation of Contour Sets compresses scalar field contours into a mesh hierarchy, preserving topology at every resolution level unlike standard grid-based wavelet schemes.
